<document id="OB-24-09" title="Operations Bulletin 24-09: Post-Helene Water Sampling Surge Staffing" family="bulletin">
<passage n="00" section="Control box">
SGW  WATER QUALITY AND COMPLIANCE

OB-24-09
OPERATIONS BULLETIN 24-09: POST-HELENE WATER SAMPLING SURGE STAFFING

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Document: OB-24-09                                                                           |
| Effective: 2024-10-02                                                                        |
| Owner: Water Quality and Compliance                                                          |
| Subject Matter Expert: Quattlebaum, Rhea D.                                                  |
| Classification: SGW Internal - Controlled                                                    |
| Approved: Water Compliance Officer, Quattlebaum, Rhea D., 2024-10-01                         |
| Approved: Water Incident Lead; Manager, Water Distribution, Sistrunk, Odell M., 2024-10-01   |
| Applies to: SC, GA systems                                                                   |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
</passage>
<passage n="01" section="1. PURPOSE; 2. APPLIES TO; 3. DIRECTION">
1. PURPOSE

Add sampling and laboratory staff so that Helene boil water notices can be lifted without delay.
Incident SGW-INC-24-0031.

2. APPLIES TO

Open notices BWA-GA-2409-07 and BWN-SC-2409-03, and any notice issued later for Helene damage.

3. DIRECTION

3.1 Meter Services releases 8 trained technicians to the Water Compliance Officer from
    2024-10-02.

3.2 Surge samplers work in pairs. Each pair is checked out on sterile technique by a Water
    Quality Technician before the first run.

3.3 The Richmond and Aiken laboratories run 06:00 to 22:00 EDT, 7 days.

3.4 A courier run leaves each staging point at 11:00 and 16:00 EDT. Samples reach the lab within
    6 h of collection.

3.5 Sample in this order:

a. zones serving hospitals, starting with WZ-PS17-CEDARFALL;

b. zones with nursing homes or dialysis centres;

c. remaining zones by connections affected.

3.6 Site selection and counts follow WQC 07.114 section 6.4 (Georgia) and WQC 07.120 section 6.4
    (South Carolina). Record each site on F-WQC-031.
</passage>
<passage n="02" section="4. STAFFING">
4. STAFFING

+---------------------------+------------+-------------------------+---------------------------+
| Team                      | Staff      | Base                    | Lead position             |
+===========================+============+=========================+===========================+
| Aiken sampling            | 3 pairs    | DEP-AIK-GRANITEVILLE    | Water Quality Technician, |
|                           |            |                         | Aiken                     |
| Richmond sampling         | 2 pairs    | Richmond water yard     | Water Quality Technician, |
|                           |            |                         | Richmond                  |
| Laboratory extended shift | 4 analysts | Aiken and Richmond labs | Laboratory Supervisor     |
+---------------------------+------------+-------------------------+---------------------------+
</passage>
<passage n="03" section="5. DURATION">
5. DURATION

In effect until the Water Compliance Officer confirms all Helene notices are lifted. Rescinded
by notice to the same distribution.

Contact: Water Compliance Officer 803-641-2245; after hours via Water Control Room 803-641-2299.
</passage>
</document>
Write one header per passage, in passage order.
